about: The device codec's cases, run by BOTH runtimes: deviceDefinitions.test.js (the editor) and CE/tests/ScriptRuntimeTests.cpp section 34 (the player). Each runtime must define or refuse each case, send the same bytes for each write, refuse each bad write in the same words and decode each dump to the same values. Every parameter is declared as "p", every dump as "d", on a role of its own. An error is the whole console line; a write's error is what deviceWrite prints. values null means the message matches no layout.
checksumNames: crc16, crc16-ccitt, crc16-modbus, crc32, crc8, kawai, offset, offset-7bit, ones, ones-complement, ones-complement-7bit, roland, roland-7bit, sum, sum-7bit, sum-8bit, twos-complement, twos-complement-7bit, twos-complement-8bit, xor, xor-7bit, yamaha

parameters.case: a CC parameter with a negative minimum says what to do instead
parameters.error: defineParameter("p"): min is -64, and a CC carries 0 to 127, so the parameter was not defined. A negative number cannot be sent. Declare the numbers the synth receives, such as min = 0 and max = 127, and add the offset in your script with ce.midi.toOffset(value, 64).

parameters.case: an NRPN parameter with a negative minimum
parameters.error: defineParameter("p"): min is -1, and an NRPN carries 0 to 16383, so the parameter was not defined. A negative number cannot be sent. Declare the numbers the synth receives, such as min = 0 and max = 16383, and add the offset in your script with ce.midi.toOffset(value, 64).

parameters.case: a CC parameter whose maximum a CC cannot carry
parameters.error: defineParameter("p"): max is 255, and a CC carries 0 to 127, so the parameter was not defined.

parameters.case: a u14 template value past 16383
parameters.error: defineParameter("p"): max is 20000, and two SysEx data bytes carry 0 to 16383, so the parameter was not defined.

parameters.case: one nibble
parameters.error: defineParameter("p"): max is 20, and one nibble carries 0 to 15, so the parameter was not defined.

parameters.case: a CC number past 127 is refused rather than clamped
parameters.error: defineParameter("p"): cc is 200, not a whole number from 0 to 127, so the parameter was not defined.

parameters.case: a CC number written as text
parameters.error: defineParameter("p"): cc is "74", not a whole number from 0 to 127, so the parameter was not defined.

parameters.case: a channel past 16
parameters.error: defineParameter("p"): channel is 17, not a whole number from 1 to 16, so the parameter was not defined.

parameters.case: an NRPN number past 127
parameters.error: defineParameter("p"): nrpn.msb is 128, not a whole number from 0 to 127, so the parameter was not defined.

parameters.case: an NRPN that is neither a pair nor { msb, lsb }
parameters.error: defineParameter("p"): the nrpn is 5, not { msb, lsb }, so the parameter was not defined.

parameters.case: too many nibbles
parameters.error: defineParameter("p"): nibbles is 9, not a whole number from 1 to 8, so the parameter was not defined.

parameters.case: a switch's on value a CC cannot carry
parameters.error: defineParameter("p"): trueValue is 200, and a CC carries 0 to 127, so the parameter was not defined.

parameters.case: a switch's on value written as a word
parameters.error: defineParameter("p"): trueValue is "on", not a whole number, so the parameter was not defined.

parameters.case: a choice that is neither a name nor { id, value }
parameters.error: defineParameter("p"): in the choices, 5 at position 1 is not a choice, so the parameter was not defined. A choice is its name, or { id, value }.

parameters.case: a choice's value a CC cannot carry
parameters.error: defineParameter("p"): the value of choice "square" is 200, and a CC carries 0 to 127, so the parameter was not defined.

parameters.case: a choice with no value
parameters.error: defineParameter("p"): the value of choice "square" is nothing, not a whole number, so the parameter was not defined.
